info.name: BookIt API
info.description: BookIt REST API v1. Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json. Times are unix timestamps in seconds.

request.description: Public. Body: email (required, valid email), password (required, 1-128 chars, must pass Django password validators), full_name (required, 1-150 chars, not blank), role (required: Client or BusinessOwner). Extra fields are rejected. Email is unique per run via a pre-request script. Responses: 201 (id, email, full_name, role), 400 invalid body, 409 email already registered.
Public. Same body as 'Register client' with role BusinessOwner. Email is unique per run via a pre-request script. Responses: 201, 400 invalid body, 409 email already registered.

Public. Body: email (required, valid email), password (required, 1-128 chars). Uses seed user client1@bookit.dev. Saves accessToken and refreshToken. Responses: 200 (access, refresh, token_type=Bearer), 400 invalid body, 401 wrong credentials, 429 rate limit (5 attempts per minute per IP, Retry-After: 60).

Public. Same body as 'Login as client', with seed user owner1@bookit.dev. Saves ownerAccessToken and ownerId (user_id claim of the JWT). Responses: 200, 400, 401, 429 rate limit (5 attempts per minute per IP, Retry-After: 60).

Public. Body: refresh (required, non-empty string, the refresh token from login). Run 'Login as client' first. Saves the new accessToken. Responses: 200 (access, token_type=Bearer), 400 invalid body, 401 invalid or expired refresh token.
Valid body with a wrong password. Expected 401 problem+json. Can also return 429 when the per-IP login limit (5 per minute) is exceeded.
Invalid email, empty password, blank full_name and unknown role. Expected 400 problem+json.
Registers the already-existing seed email client1@bookit.dev. Expected 409 problem+json.

request.description: JWT required (bearer {{accessToken}}). Run 'Login as client' and 'Login as owner' first. Query: category (optional, BusinessCategory, any case), search (optional, name substring, any case, max 200), order (optional, asc|desc, default asc, by name), limit (optional, 1-100, default 20), offset (optional, >= 0, default 0). Response 200: {count, limit, offset, next, previous, results: [{id, name, category, owner_id, owner_name, services: [{id, name, duration_minutes, price}]}]}. Saves businessId, serviceId, ownerBusinessId (owner_id == ownerId) and otherBusinessId. Errors: 400 invalid query (problem+json with errors[{field, message}]), 401 missing or invalid token.

header.description: Optional. Replaces the body in the idempotency hash. Same user + same key within 10 minutes returns 409.

request.description: JWT required, Client role only (bearer {{accessToken}}). Run 'Login as client' and 'List businesses' first. Body: service_id (required, int > 0), start_time (required, positive unix seconds, must be in the future). Extra fields are rejected. Optional header Idempotency-Key: if sent, its value replaces the body in the duplicate-detection hash. The same user sending the same body (key order and spacing ignored) or key within 10 minutes gets 409; a failed (4xx) booking releases the key. A pre-request script sets bookingStartTime to a whole hour 1-60 days ahead plus a random hour offset, so reruns do not collide. Response 201: {id, status: Pending, start_time, end_time, service_id, service_name, price, business_id, business_name, client_id, client_name}. Errors: 400 invalid body, past start time or unknown service id, 401 missing or invalid token, 403 caller is a business owner, 409 duplicate booking request or slot overlaps an active appointment of the same service.

exec: pm.test('Duplicate detail', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql('Duplicate booking request. The same booking was already submitted.'));

request.description: Run right after 'Book appointment'. Same body, same client token, no new pre-request script, within 10 minutes. The idempotency middleware returns 409 problem+json with detail 'Duplicate booking request. The same booking was already submitted.'

request.description: JWT required (bearer {{accessToken}}). A client sees their own appointments; an owner sees appointments of their own businesses (use bearer {{ownerAccessToken}}). Query: from, to (optional, positive unix seconds, inclusive, from <= to), status (optional, Pending|Confirmed|Cancelled, any case), limit (optional, 1-100, default 20), offset (optional, >= 0, default 0). Response 200: {count, limit, offset, next, previous, results: [appointment]}. Errors: 400 invalid query (problem+json with errors[{field, message}]), 401 missing or invalid token.

Public. The pre-request script sends 5 wrong-password logins with pm.sendRequest, then this request is the 6th. It uses up the per-IP login budget (LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT, default 5 per minute) for one minute, so any login in the next minute also returns 429. Keep it last in the run. Expected 429 problem+json with Retry-After: 60 and detail 'Too many login attempts. Try again later.'.
